query:
INSERT INTO quickfireQuestions
  (type, question, reviewAnswer, echoCategory, category, difficulty, isActive, submissionStatus)
VALUES
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the PCA on TCD?','<60 cm/s (mean ~40–50 cm/s)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the cerebrovascular reactivity test on TCD?','Breath-holding or CO2 challenge — assesses cerebral autoregulation; BHI >0.69 is normal','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the De Quervain tenosynovitis on MSK ultrasound?','Thickening and hypoechogenicity of the 1st extensor compartment tendons (APL, EPB) with fluid in the sheath','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal iliopsoas tendon appearance on MSK ultrasound?','Hyperechoic, fibrillar, anterior to the hip joint; snapping hip = dynamic subluxation','msk','MSK','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a Baker cyst?','Anechoic or hypoechoic cyst in the posteromedial popliteal fossa between the medial gastrocnemius and semimembranosus tendons','msk','MSK','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal appendix testis appearance?','Small oval structure at the superior pole of the testis — can torse independently','scrotum','Scrotum','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a scrotal hematoma?','Heterogeneous, complex fluid collection; may contain echogenic clot','scrotum','Scrotum','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a Leydig cell tumor?','Small, hypoechoic intratesticular nodule — most common benign testicular stromal tumor','scrotum','Scrotum','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal scrotal wall thickness?','2–8 mm','scrotum','Scrotum','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS)?','May be occult on ultrasound; when visible: hypoechoic, irregular, with microcalcifications','breast','Breast','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a breast abscess?','Complex, thick-walled fluid collection with internal echoes and surrounding hyperemia','breast','Breast','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal breast duct diameter?','<2 mm (duct ectasia = >3 mm)','breast','Breast','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of fat necrosis in the breast?','Variable — may appear as anechoic oil cyst, complex mass, or echogenic mass with posterior shadowing','breast','Breast','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal inferior vena cava (IVC) diameter?','<2.1 cm (collapsibility >50% = low CVP)','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the M-mode of the IVC used for?','Assessing volume status — IVC diameter and collapsibility index estimate CVP and fluid responsiveness','pocus','POCUS','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the difference between CW and PW Doppler?','CW = continuous wave, no range gate, measures all velocities along the beam; PW = pulsed wave, range-gated, measures at a specific depth but limited by Nyquist','physics','Physics','intermediate',1,'draft')
